answer: The umber index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the canyon queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1250 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the summit. Honest users pay that once, farms 24 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
